title: SciML/DifferentialEquations.jl
summary: DifferentialEquations.jl is a high-performance Julia library providing solvers for ordinary differential equations (ODEs), stochastic differential equations (SDEs), delay differential equations (DDEs), differential-algebraic equations (DAEs), and stochastic partial differential equations (SPDEs), with integration for scientific machine learning workflows.
problem_solved: Provides reliable, high-performance numerical solvers for solving complex differential equations in scientific computing and machine learning applications.
why_valuable: Offers a comprehensive, well-optimized suite of differential equation solvers that bridges traditional scientific computing with modern AI/ML, enabling researchers to efficiently model and simulate complex dynamical systems.
